rubrics.justification: Describes the embryo as a good-quality day-5 blastocyst broadly consistent with 3AA, noting visible cavity, intact zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE. Appropriate caveat about limits of a single static image; minor uncertainty in calling it early/less expanded prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, unexplained diagnosis, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors. Slight overinterpretation of prior biochemical/ectopic as implantation-site issues and some speculative future-workup points keep it from perfect.

Generally aligned with IVF practice: supports single embryo transfer, recognizes limits of morphology, cautious stance on PGT-A in a 27-year-old, and recommends early ectopic surveillance. Minor deviations include somewhat speculative add-on discussions and broad comments about FET superiority.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, early beta-hCG/ultrasound monitoring, uterine/tubal evaluation, lining optimization, and weight management.
